reviewStatus: Drafted from verified sources; pending independent clinician review before clinical release.
commonErrors: Treating female sex alone as a risk factor.
name: CHA₂DS₂-VASc Score

version.label: CHA₂DS₂-VASc (Lip et al. 2010)
version.detail: Total 0–9. The 2024 ESC guideline's CHA₂DS₂-VA (sex category removed) is a different version and is not combined.

purpose: Estimates thromboembolic stroke risk in non-valvular atrial fibrillation.
intendedPopulation: Adults with atrial fibrillation without moderate-severe mitral stenosis or mechanical valves.

inputDefinitions.label: Congestive heart failure or LV dysfunction
Vascular disease (previous MI, peripheral arterial disease or aortic plaque)

resultStates.label: Female sex only
resultStates.summary: CHA₂DS₂-VASc 1 from female sex alone, which is not regarded as a risk factor on its own.

resultStates.label: CHA₂DS₂-VASc 1
resultStates.detail: Decisions depend on the guideline in use and patient factors, including bleeding risk.

resultStates.label: CHA₂DS₂-VASc {total}
resultStates.summary: Two or more points: higher annual stroke risk with each point.
resultStates.detail: Guideline thresholds for anticoagulation differ by version and sex; integrate with bleeding risk and patient preference.

clinicalContext.text: Estimates thromboembolic risk in atrial fibrillation; used with a bleeding risk score.
Relevant in stroke clinic for secondary prevention after AF-related stroke (previous stroke scores 2).

clinicalInsights.text: After stroke or TIA the score is at least 2; risk factors and bleeding risk still guide shared decisions.
Assess bleeding risk alongside (e.g. HAS-BLED) and address modifiable risk factors.

limitations.text: Derived for non-valvular atrial fibrillation; not for mechanical valves or moderate-severe mitral stenosis.

limitations: Event rates per point vary between cohorts.
Does not include renal function, AF burden or imaging markers.

confounders.effect: Under-scores vascular disease or prior TIA.
e.g. what counts as vascular disease.

guideSections.what: A 0–9 point score of stroke risk factors in atrial fibrillation.
guideSections.whenToUse: Atrial fibrillation, including after stroke or TIA.
guideSections.howToPerform: Score each factor present: CHF 1, hypertension 1, age 75+ 2, diabetes 1, prior stroke/TIA/thromboembolism 2, vascular disease 1, age 65–74 1, female sex 1.
guideSections.clinicalContext: One input to anticoagulation decisions with bleeding risk and patient preference.

sources.citation: Lip GYH, Nieuwlaat R, Pisters R, Lane DA, Crijns HJGM. Refining clinical risk stratification for predicting stroke and thromboembolism in atrial fibrillation using a novel risk factor-based approach: the Euro Heart Survey on Atrial Fibrillation. Chest. 2010;137(2):263-272.

components.label: Congestive heart failure or LV dysfunction
Vascular disease (previous MI, peripheral arterial disease or aortic plaque)
